items.difficulty_reason: Relative (direct image) form of the Cech-to-derived spectral sequence: notes that the hypotheses coincide with lemma-cech-to-cohomology so the standing remarks carry over, resolves g_* I by the exact sequence of pushforwards along g f_p, forms the double complex and identifies the second spectral sequence's E_1 page as R^q(g f_p)_* f_p^{-1} F using lemma-pullback-injective. Retained author proof at lines 3801-3831.
